title: Copilot Studio: agent responses in Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat match Copilot Chat's own
summary: The roadmap description, blocking instructions and API match their sources. However, blocking is incorrectly presented as the only documented control, although Microsoft also documents agent sharing and channel availability controls. Narrow that statement so administrators do not mistake whole-agent blocking for their only option.
